answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 8620 Country: United States of America Title: Respected Scholar: Last night in taraweeh prayers, Shafia Imam by mistake made salam after 3 rakah of taraweeh prayers. After salam people informed the imam that he had made 3 rakahs and should repeat the salah, but Shafia Sheikh/Scholar told the Imam to continue and make the next taraweeh salah only one rakah. Is this combination of 3 1 salah in taraweeh acceptable. Is taraweeh salah valid in this situation for a Hanafi follower. Should the imam had repeated the salah. The Imam also didn?t made prostration of forgetfulness at the end of the salah. Question: Respected Scholar: Last night in taraweeh prayers, Shafia Imam by mistake made salam after 3 rakah of taraweeh prayers. After salam people informed the imam that he had made 3 rakahs and should repeat the salah, but Shafia Sheikh/Scholar told the Imam to continue and make the next taraweeh salah only one rakah. Is this combination of 3 1 salah in taraweeh acceptable. Is taraweeh salah valid in this situation for a Hanafi follower. Should the imam had repeated the salah. The Imam also didn?t made prostration of forgetfulness at the end of the salah. Answer ID: 8620 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 19026/1794=D/1429) According to the Hanfi Fiqh, there is no salah having single rakah , so the Hanfi followers will have to re-perform the salah . If the Imam had stood for the third rakah after having sat at two rakah , then there are only two rakah of qaza to be compulsorily performed, otherwise if he had not sat at the two rakah , then there are four rakah of qaza (two by two) to be performed necessarily. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
